verdict.rationale: dLocal's own docs list "Mass payouts" as a product capability. That is a first-party bulk operation, but it rests on a single one-line mention with no detail on how batches are submitted or managed. Nothing shows bulk operations beyond payouts. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints and request formats, bulk operations for other item types (payments, refunds, enrollments), limits and error handling for batches, hands-on or independent corroboration.
